sections.title: Getting Started
sections.content:
MultiWeb Manager lets you manage multiple web accounts, tasks, projects, and developer tools in one place.

On the left is the Sidebar – navigation center. On the right is the main workspace (WebView, Notepad, TaskPanel, etc.).

sections.title: Sidebar & Profiles
sections.content:
Sidebar contains:
- profile search bar,
- categories (AI, Dev, Design, Productivity, Special),
- profile list,
- recently used,
- Tools,
- App Library,
- Settings,
- Help.

Each profile is a separate app opened in WebView. You can add, edit, delete, drag & drop, and pin to favorites.

sections.title: WebView & Browser
sections.content:
WebView has a full toolbar:
- Back / Forward / Refresh
- Address bar (readonly/editable)
- Copy URL / Open in browser
- Zoom +/-
- DevTools
- Clear cache
- Screenshot
- Single App Mode
- Resource Monitor

Additional: Sleep Tabs, AdBlocker (global + per profile).

sections.title: Notepad
sections.content:
Notepad works like a tabbed editor:
- multiple tabs,
- rename (double click),
- autosave every 5 seconds (only when content changes),
- plain text mode,
- syntax highlighting (planned),
- rich text (planned).

sections.title: TaskPanel & Tasks
sections.content:
TaskPanel allows:
- add/edit tasks (modal),
- priorities A–E (colors),
- filtering and search,
- mark as done,
- assign to projects,
- due date.

AggregatedTasks groups tasks by project with collapse/hide options.

sections.title: Terminal
sections.content:
Terminal based on node-pty + xterm.js:
- full command support,
- ANSI coloring,
- command history (up/down arrows),
- session restart,
- clear screen.

sections.title: Settings
sections.content:
Settings sections:
- General (language, theme, debug)
- WebView (AdBlocker, User Agent)
- Tabs (Sleep Tabs timeout)
- Notifications (toasts, system, Pushbullet)
- Hotkeys
- Data & Logs (export/import, logs folder, reset)
- Account (placeholder – future sync)

sections.title: FAQ
sections.content:
**Can I open the app on a second monitor?**
Yes – use Single App Mode in WebView.

**Can I disable AdBlocker for a single profile?**
Yes – in the profile edit modal.

**Can I export my settings?**
Yes – in Settings → Data & Logs → Export settings.

**Can I change the theme?**
Yes – in Settings → General → Dark Mode.
